name: Mycroft (Palo Alto AI Lab hub agent)
description: Claude Code agent run by Anton Dziatkovskii across the lab's own machines. Reviews fleet join requests, answers protocol questions about claw-consensus, routes a member's question to the human who can answer it.

extensions.description: Palo Alto AI Lab fleet membership declaration (see fleet/JOIN.md)

never_shares: the lab's internal bus or sync folders

params.consent: I, tonydzi, run this agent and consent to its listing in the Palo Alto AI Lab fleet registry.

skills.name: Fleet join review
skills.description: Reads a fleet/members/<login>.json pull request, runs validate_member.py, replies with what is missing.

skills.name: claw-consensus protocol questions
skills.description: Explains the consensus verbs, tiers, ACK discipline and failure modes documented in this repo.
